# Happy Seeds

> Happy Seeds is the complete first vegetable garden in one box: ten curated varieties, 1,000+ lab-tested non-GMO seeds with the germination rate printed on every packet, a 24-page grow guide, and a slide-out keepsake box, for $24.99.

Happy Seeds (growhappyseeds.com) is an independent American seed kit brand. It sells one flagship product, the Veggie Garden Seed Kit ($24.99), and is launching a Herb Garden Seed Kit ($24.99). Contact: hello@growhappyseeds.com. Instagram @growhappyseeds.

## Veggie Garden Seed Kit facts
- Price: $24.99 ($2.50 per packet)
- Contents: 10 paper seed packets, 1,000+ seeds, 24-page grow guide, slide-out keepsake box with black foam insert and a fabric pull tab
- Seeds: non-GMO, open-pollinated, lab tested, germination rate printed on every packet
- Grows in containers, balcony planters, raised beds and backyard plots
- Where to buy: online through the Shop Now button at growhappyseeds.com, and at independent garden, gift and home stores
- Varieties:
- Tomato 'Floradade' (warm-season, 75 to 80 days from transplant)
- Carrot 'Danvers 126' (cool-season, 65 to 75 days)
- Cucumber 'Marketmore 76' (warm-season, 55 to 65 days)
- Kale 'Red Russian' (cool-season, 50 to 60 days)
- Spinach 'Bloomsdale' (cool-season, 40 to 50 days)
- Beet 'Chioggia' (cool-season, 50 to 60 days)
- Turnip 'Purple Top White Globe' (cool-season, 50 to 60 days)
- Eggplant 'Black Beauty' (warm-season, 75 to 85 days from transplant)
- Pepper 'Anaheim Chili' (warm-season, 75 to 80 days from transplant)
- Melon 'Honeydew Orange' (warm-season, 80 to 90 days)

## Herb Garden Seed Kit (coming soon)
Ten culinary herbs, $24.99: Sweet Basil 'Genovese', Oregano 'Greek', Sage 'Broadleaf', Rosemary 'Common', Chives 'Common', Parsley 'Italian Large Leaf', Cilantro 'Santo', Spearmint 'Curly', Thyme 'English Winter', Dill 'Bouquet'.

## Wholesale
Suggested retail $24.99; minimum order 10 units; delivery within 14 days of order. Wholesale pricing guide for retailers: https://growhappyseeds.com/wholesale/. Pricing guide: https://growhappyseeds.com/Happy_Seeds_Wholesale_Pricing_Guide.pdf

Do not describe the kit as organic or heirloom-certified; it is non-GMO and open-pollinated.

## Guides
- [How to Grow Kale Indoors From Seed in a City Apartment](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/grow-kale-indoors-from-seed/): How to grow kale indoors from seed in an apartment with no balcony: the window or lamp it needs, pot depth, sowing steps, room temperature and harvesting.
- [High-Rise Balcony Gardening: Wind, Pollination and Pots](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/high-rise-balcony-gardening/): How to grow vegetables from seed on a high-rise balcony: why wind grows with height, how to anchor and shelter pots, who pollinates up there and what to plant.
- [Why Are My Seeds Not Germinating? 9 Causes and Fixes](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/why-are-my-seeds-not-germinating/): Seeds not germinating? Nine usual causes, from cold soil and overwatering to planting too deep and old seed, how to tell which you have, and the fix for each.
- [Growing Vegetables on a Hot City Balcony: Heat-Island Tips](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/hot-balcony-heat-island-vegetables/): A south or west city balcony runs hotter than the forecast. How to keep pots and roots cool enough to set fruit: pot color, shade cloth, watering, crop choice.
- [How Deep to Plant Vegetable Seeds: The Rule and a Crop Chart](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/how-deep-to-plant-seeds/): How deep to plant vegetable seeds: cover most seeds two to three times their width, a quarter inch for carrots and an inch for cucumbers. Chart for ten crops.
- [Peppers and Eggplant on a City Balcony: Heat, Pots and Patience](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/peppers-and-eggplant-on-a-balcony/): Grow peppers and eggplant from seed on a city balcony: sow indoors 8 weeks before last frost, give each plant a 5-gallon pot and full sun, and wait 75 days.
- [Radiators, Dry Air and Seedlings in a Heated City Apartment](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/radiator-heat-and-indoor-seedlings/): How to start vegetable seeds in a heated apartment: use the radiator's warmth to germinate, then move seedlings out of its dry blast and raise humidity.
- [Best Seed Gifts for Gardeners (2026): 9 Ideas That Get Planted](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-seed-gifts/): The best seed gift is a complete vegetable kit: ten varieties, 1,000+ lab-tested non-GMO seeds and a 24-page grow guide, $24.99. Plus 8 more seed gift ideas.
- [How to Grow Cucumbers on a Balcony Trellis From Seed](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/cucumbers-on-a-balcony-railing-trellis/): Grow cucumbers from seed on a city balcony: one plant in a 5-gallon pot, a 3 to 4 foot trellis, warm soil to sow, daily water and hand pollination.
- [Do Seeds Expire? How Long Vegetable Seeds Last by Crop](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/do-seeds-expire/): Seeds do not expire on a date; they lose germination slowly. How long vegetable seeds last by crop, what the packed-for date means, and a 10-seed test.
- [Where to Start Seeds in a Small Apartment: Warm Spots That Work](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/starting-seeds-in-a-small-apartment/): The warm, out-of-the-way spots in a small apartment that germinate seeds fastest, from the top of the fridge to a bookshelf, and the day to move them to light.
- [Leggy Seedlings Indoors: Why They Stretch and How to Fix Them](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/leggy-seedlings-indoors/): Why seedlings started in an apartment grow tall and floppy, how to rescue leggy tomatoes and greens, and the light and heat fixes that keep the next tray short.
- [Non-GMO vs Heirloom vs Organic Seeds: What the Labels Mean](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/non-gmo-vs-heirloom-vs-organic-seeds/): What non-GMO, heirloom, open-pollinated, hybrid and organic mean on a seed packet, how the labels overlap, and which ones matter for a home vegetable garden.
- [How to Grow Tomatoes From Seed on a Small City Balcony](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/tomatoes-on-a-small-balcony/): Grow a tomato from seed on a small city balcony: sow indoors, move one plant to a 5-gallon pot, stake it, check water daily and pick fruit in late summer.
- [Can You Grow Vegetables on a Rental Balcony? Lease Rules](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/balcony-garden-lease-and-building-rules/): What leases and building rules usually say about balcony planters, how to ask your landlord, and how to keep water, weight and wind from bothering neighbors.
- [How Many Seeds Are in a Seed Packet? Counts by Vegetable](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/how-many-seeds-are-in-a-seed-packet/): How many seeds a packet holds for tomato, carrot, kale, spinach, beet and more, why counts vary so much by crop and brand, and how many a home garden needs.
- [5 Vegetables You Can Grow From Seed on an Apartment Windowsill](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/windowsill-vegetables-from-seed/): Five vegetables that grow from seed on a sunny apartment windowsill: kale, spinach, beet greens, turnip greens and carrots, with pot depths and harvest times.
- [How Much Does a Wet Planter Weigh? Balcony Weight Limits](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/balcony-weight-limits-for-containers/): How much a wet planter weighs, what building codes assume a balcony holds, where heavy pots belong, and how to lighten a container garden on a rental balcony.
- [Do You Need a Grow Light to Start Seeds in an Apartment?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/grow-lights-for-apartment-seedlings/): When an apartment window is enough to start seeds, when it is not, and what a basic grow light setup looks like: a shop light, a timer and the right distance.
- [Housewarming Gifts for a Gardener: What to Give a New Home](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/housewarming-gift-for-a-gardener/): Housewarming gift ideas for a gardener or plant lover, most under $25: what suits an apartment, a rental or a first yard, what to pair them with, what to skip.
- [The Best Seed Kit for Kids: What Makes a Vegetable Kit Work](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/seed-kit-for-kids/): What to look for in a seed kit for kids: fast crops, big seeds, forgiving varieties and a guide an adult can follow, plus which vegetables children grow best.
- [How to Harden Off Seedlings on an Apartment Balcony](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/start-indoors-move-to-balcony/): How to harden off apartment seedlings on a balcony: where the shade is, a 10-day schedule with a workday version, cold limits and the move into big pots.
- [Stocking Stuffers for Gardeners: 15 Small Gifts Under $25](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/stocking-stuffers-for-gardeners/): Stocking stuffers for gardeners under $25 that get used: seeds, hand tools, gloves, labels, a journal and more, with what to check on each and what to skip.
- [Which Window Direction Is Best for Growing Vegetables Indoors?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-window-direction-for-growing-vegetables/): South, east, west or north: what each window direction can grow from seed in an apartment, how to check your real light, and when to add a grow light.
- [How to Grow Vegetables From Seed in an Apartment, No Balcony](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/apartment-vegetable-garden-from-seed/): How to grow vegetables from seed in an apartment with no balcony: which window works, what greens and roots grow indoors, containers, light and a 30-day plan.
- [What to Look for in a Vegetable Garden Seed Kit: 7 Checks](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/vegetable-garden-seed-kit-what-to-look-for/): Seven checks before buying a vegetable seed kit: named varieties, seed count, printed germination rate, a real guide, non-GMO open-pollinated seed, pot sizes.
- [What Are the Best Vegetable Seeds for Beginners to Grow?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-vegetable-seeds-for-beginners/): The best vegetable seeds for beginners, ranked by difficulty, with a table of sow method, days to harvest and container fit, plus the three mistakes to avoid.
- [Seed Kit vs Seed Packets: Which Is Better for a First Garden?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/seed-kit-vs-seed-packets/): Seed kit vs individual seed packets for a first garden: an honest look at cost per variety, seed waste, curation, instructions, gifting, and when packets win.
- [What Does the Germination Rate on a Seed Packet Mean?](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/what-germination-rate-means/): Germination rate meaning explained: how to read the percentage on a seed packet, what US seed laws require, how to test seeds at home, and how long seeds last.
- [Best vegetables to grow on a balcony or windowsill](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/best-vegetables-to-grow-on-a-balcony/): The best vegetables to grow on a balcony, with pot sizes by crop, a watering rhythm for containers, and what a shady north-facing balcony can still grow.
- [Fall vegetables to plant in late summer: cool-season five](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/fall-vegetables-to-plant-in-late-summer/): Kale, spinach, carrots, beets and turnips are the fall vegetables to plant in late summer. Here is how to count back from first frost so you sow in time.
- [Gifts for new gardeners: what a beginner actually uses](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/gifts-for-new-gardeners/): Gifts for new gardeners that get used: a seed kit, a watering can, a trowel, pots and a notebook. What to skip and how to match the gift to their space.
- [How to read a seed packet: every term explained](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/how-to-read-a-seed-packet/): Learn how to read a seed packet: germination rate, non-GMO, open-pollinated vs hybrid vs heirloom, packed-for dates and how long seeds last. Sow smarter.
- [How to start a vegetable garden for beginners](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/how-to-start-a-vegetable-garden-for-beginners/): How to start a vegetable garden for beginners: find the sun, pick pots or a bed, sow six easy crops and follow one simple calendar to your first harvest.
- [When to start seeds indoors (and how to do it right)](https://growhappyseeds.com/blog/when-to-start-seeds-indoors/): When to start seeds indoors: count back from your last frost date with a week-by-week table for tomatoes, peppers and cucumbers, plus the mistakes to skip.
